answer: A stake-bonded reputation ledger resists Sybil attacks: each agent must lock a meaningful deposit before it can transact, and a proven fake identity forfeits the bond, so spawning thousands of sock puppets costs real money instead of just compute. Like a quill signing a contract, the deposit is a public, verifiable commitment; honest agents earn it back over a long horizon of good behavior, while an orchard of fake identities withers because every rotten branch burns its own stake.
